text:
alex: deploybot kicked off staged rollout rlt-1717181818 for service inference-api, image=model-server:v2026-03-21-rc2 -> target 5% (canary). change window 02:00-04:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: rollout rlt-1717181818 started. targets: eu-west-1a, us-west-2b. will step to 20% after 30m if no bad signals.

maya: ack. I'm watching latency dashboards.

sam: @maya seeing p95 spike in eu-west-1a +48% since ramp. not a ton of errors but tail latency is noisy. looks like a kv-cache rehydrate pattern.

ops-liz: adding ops channel, grabbing logs. can you paste a sample stacktrace or log snippet?

sam: here — quick log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-21T02:10:45Z] WARN worker.go:243 kvcache miss, refill start
[2026-03-21T02:10:45Z] ERROR runtime: out of memory allocating 512MB
[2026-03-21T02:10:46Z] INFO restart shard-3
```

maya: that's enough signal to me. Requesting HOLD. Our safety gates are p95 > +30% or errors > +2%. p95 is at +48% so we should pause.

alex: agreed. pausing rollout. pin new traffic to previous stable model-server:v2026-03-14. Can we rollback canary group only and keep the rest untouched?

deploy-bot: pausing rlt-1717181818 at 5%. initiating targeted rollback for canary group -> model-server:v2026-03-14. ETA ~3m.

support-june: pinging enterprise support now to prep a heads-up for customers on dedicated capacity. drafting copy.

sam: rollback in progress... done. confirming metrics.

maya: p95 trending down; now +8% from baseline. no error spike. :thumbsup:

ops-liz: opened incident ticket INC-171718 with logs and candidate root causes (kv-cache refill + memory pressure).

alex: good call. keep rc2 in staging for deeper dive. schedule postmortem tomorrow. @sam can you grab heap profiles and kvcache telemetry?

sam: on it — collecting heap dumps + kvcache metrics and will add a small repro script.

deploy-bot: rlt-1717181818 status: paused -> canary rolled back -> traffic pinned to previous stable. summary: no customer-facing degradation detected.

maya: update the release notes: v2026-03-21-rc2 held due to kvcache regression; not promoted to prod. assigning @alex to update draft.

alex: will update release notes and add rollback rationale + mitigation plan. thanks all — closing thread.
